name: @qf-jarvis/rag-provisioning
description: QF Jarvis RAG provisioning boundary (QFJ-P04.05 ADR-0053; JF-3 ADR-0148). Three modes (DISABLED, PROVISIONED_NO_OP, ACTIVE) and no enabled=true; absent/malformed config fails closed to DISABLED; the no-op path is unchanged and still returns an immutable content-free NO_OP result with exact zero counters. ACTIVE performs deterministic EXACT retrieval delegated to @qf-jarvis/governed-knowledge under an exact profile-to-backend knowledge-revision binding, and ships a revision-bound production knowledge pack that currently holds ZERO records. No embeddings, vector database, semantic search, similarity ranking, free-text query, chunking, indexing, external service, network, or side effect; no database/schema/migration; no live model call, key, token, or provider activation. Depends only on zod and the governed-knowledge authority.
